title: Same chemistry, three orders of magnitude in price
subtitle: U.S. list price at launch, per patient per year (one-time for exa-cel). Log scale; net prices are lower.

items.label: inclisiran (LDL cholesterol)
items.detail: $3,250 per injection, two maintenance doses a year (2021 launch). Large population: people with high LDL.

items.label: patisiran (hATTR amyloidosis)
items.detail: Average annual list price at 2018 launch; expected net price about $345,000.

items.label: olezarsen (FCS)
items.detail: Annual list price at December 2024 launch for familial chylomicronemia syndrome, an ultra-rare disease.

items.label: nusinersen (SMA), year one
items.detail: $125,000 per injection; six doses in year one, three ($375,000) in later years (2016 launch).

items.label: exa-cel (sickle cell), one-time
items.detail: One-time ex vivo CRISPR therapy (2023 launch). Not chronic dosing, so not directly comparable.
